title: Cream Cheese Brownies
description:
Another family favorite for the young and the young at heart are brownies. While the Betty Crocker Original Supreme variety is easiest and always a treat, for those occasions when you have a little more time and want to make something extra special, try these cream cheese brownies. The recipe isn’t difficult, but has several steps. The brownies are worth every minute of the preparation time!
START TO FINISH: 1 HOUR
Cream Cheese Brownies
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Break chocolate into 8 pieces and melt with 3 tablespoons butter over low heat, stirring constantly.
Remove chocolate/butter mixture from the heat and allow to cool.
Cream remaining butter with the cream cheese.
ingredients: 1 package (4 ounces) Baker’s German Sweet Chocolate
Gradually add ¼ cup sugar; cream well after each addition.
Blend in 1 egg, 1 tablespoon flour and ½ teaspoon vanilla. Set aside.
directions: Beat 2 eggs until thick and light in color. Gradually add ¾ cup sugar, beating until thickened.
Add baking powder, salt and ½ cup flour.
Blend in chocolate mixture, nuts (if desired), 1 teaspoon vanilla, and almond extract.
Spread about half the batter into a buttered 8 or 9 inch square pan. Spread cheese mixture over the top of the batter.
Spoon remaining chocolate batter on top of cheese mixture.
Zigzag through batters with a rounded knife or spatula to marbleize.
Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the brownies comes out dry and clean.
Cool; then cut. Enjoy with a cold glass of milk!!
